user_query: Determine the most likely biological function of this protein from its sequence. Assess domain architecture, homologous proteins, cellular localization, GO/function annotations, and whether the evidence supports a specific enzymatic or structural role. Clearly distinguish curated evidence from homology-based inference and report important uncertainty.

warnings: Sequence-derived estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing, PTMs, bound ligands, or oligomers.
